name: read_file

target_file.description: The path of the file to read. You can use a relative path in the workspace or an absolute path.

offset.description: The line number to start reading from. Only provide it if the file is too large to read at once.

limit.description: The number of lines to read. Only provide it if the file is too large to read at once.

description:
Read a file.

Usage:
- target_file can be a relative path in the workspace or an absolute path.
- By default, it reads up to 1000 lines starting from the beginning of the file.
- Results are returned with line numbers starting at 1 in the format LINE_NUMBER→LINE_CONTENT.
- Reading records the file's current state so a later write can detect if somebody else changed it first.
